about: Incorporated in June 2022, Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited is an integrated agro-processing company engaged in the manufacturing of Jaggery Powder, Khandsari Sugar, jaggery-based value-added food products, and sugarcane by-products. The company also operates a Cane Seed nursery, enabling backward integration in sugarcane cultivation. It serves both B2B customers through jaggery powder, Khandsari sugar, and by-products, and B2C customers through its "Feel Guddy" branded jaggery-based premix products, including Jaggery Tea, Jaggery Coffee, Instant Rice Kheer, Jaggery Laddoo, and Jaggery Lapsi.

The company follows an integrated sugarcane processing model, utilizing sugarcane to manufacture primary products while efficiently monetizing by-products such as bagasse, molasses, press mud, and ash. With backward integration into sugarcane seed cultivation, captive processing facilities, and a focus on sustainable and zero-waste manufacturing, the company has established a diversified product portfolio catering to both industrial and retail markets.
Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries emphasizes operational efficiency, quality control, sustainable manufacturing practices, and product innovation.
As of March 31, 2026, the company employed 155 permanent personnel across production, engineering, agriculture, administration, sales, finance, security, and other operational functions.

about: Incorporated on February 17, 2014, Airpro Technology India Limited is a technology-driven company engaged in the design, assembly, distribution and servicing of wired and wireless networking products and solutions. The Company operates as a brand owner, providing networking solutions for enterprises and institutions to establish and manage reliable, scalable and cost-effective connectivity infrastructure. The Company offers a range of networking products, including wireless access points, WLAN controllers, Ethernet switches, gateways, outdoor wireless solutions, 4G/5G Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) and industrial Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches. Its products cater to different deployment environments, including enterprise networks, campuses, industrial facilities and locations requiring wireless broadband connectivity.

In addition to hardware products, the Company provides software-enabled networking solutions through its cloud-based platform, AirproCloud, which enables customers to configure, monitor and manage network infrastructure remotely. The platform supports centralised monitoring of networking devices, bandwidth utilisation, user access controls and network performance analytics and is currently available on Android-based devices. The Company also develops customised firmware for certain white-label products, supporting customer-specific requirements such as user authentication, bandwidth allocation and network access management.

The Company follows a hybrid business model comprising product design, firmware customisation, cloud-based network management, in-house assembly and white-label networking solutions. It markets its products under its own brand through distributors and online channel partners, including e-commerce platforms, and primarily operates through a B2B model. Its customer base spans multiple industry verticals.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 39 permanent employees across management, sales and marketing, software development, legal and secretarial, accounts and finance, IT and technical support, and support functions.

about: Incorporated on June 23, 2004 , Matangi Rubber Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of tyres, tyre flaps, tyre tubes and rubber compounds. It primarily caters to the two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyre segments, while its tyre flaps and tubes are used in commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses and heavy utility vehicles. The Company operates through three business models: manufacturing and selling, contract manufacturing and job work services. Under its manufacturing and selling model, it manufactures and sells tyre tubes under its own brand. Its contract manufacturing activities primarily involve producing customised tyre flaps bearing clients’ logos, while its job work services involve processing raw materials supplied by customers into tyres, tyre flaps and tubes in return for conversion charges. The Company also manufactures rubber compounds used in the production of other rubber products.

The Company operates five manufacturing plants across three locations, comprising two facilities at Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, two facilities at Bhind, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, and one facility at Gummidipoondi, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These facilities support the manufacturing of tyre flaps, tyre tubes, two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyres and rubber compounds. Its operations are supported by in-house production infrastructure, testing equipment and warehousing facilities for storing raw materials, finished goods and scrap.
The Company has an established manufacturing relationship with JK Tyre and also serves other customers through contract manufacturing and job work arrangements.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 285 employees across its offices and manufacturing locations.

about: Incorporated on September 29, 2005, Monomark Engineering (India) Limited is engaged in providing Industrial Operations and Maintenance (“O&M”) services, Metal Fabrication solutions and Industrial Project Execution services to industrial clients across sectors such as metals, cement, ports and engineering/OEMs. The Company’s business is organised into three segments: Industrial O&M Services, Metal Fabrication Solutions and Industrial Project Execution Services. Its O&M services include production support, plant operations, preventive and breakdown maintenance, equipment monitoring and technical support. Its metal fabrication activities involve manufacturing customised sheet metal components and structural products based on client specifications and engineering drawings. Under its project execution segment, the Company undertakes engineering, procurement and construction (“EPC”) contracts, as well as on-site fabrication, erection, installation and commissioning (“FEIC”) assignments involving heavy machinery, piping, structural steel and industrial equipment.

The Company operates a dedicated metal fabrication facility at Kapasan, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, with an annual installed capacity of 4,000 MT. Its execution capabilities are supported by an in-house fleet of 232 industrial vehicles and equipment, including forklifts, trucks, excavators, cranes, hydra machines, bulldozers and loaders. This equipment base, together with its technical workforce, enables the Company to manage site-level logistics, mobilise resources and execute operational and project-related activities across multiple locations.

The Company serves industrial clients across the metals, ports, cement and engineering/OEM sectors, with an established client base that includes Vedanta Group, Adani Group, Aditya Birla Group, L&T Group, Tata Group, JK Lakshmi Cement Group and Shree Cement Group. It operates across seven Indian states and has an overseas subsidiary, Monomark Engineering FZE, in the United Arab Emirates, through which it provides O&M services to Fujairah Gold FZC.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 28 ongoing projects, comprising 21 O&M projects and 7 Industrial Project Execution projects. It reported a running unexecuted order book of ₹1,76,192.16 lakh as of the same date.
As of September 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 7,608 employees, comprising 958 fixed employees and 6,650 project-specific employees.

about: Incorporated in 2008, Integris Medtech Ltd is a diversified India-based global medical products and laboratory solutions company. The company develops, manufactures, commercialises, and sells a broad portfolio of medical devices and solutions spanning cardiovascular devices, clinical diagnostics, and scientific laboratory solutions.

Integris Medtech operates manufacturing facilities in India, Germany, and the Netherlands, supplying products to more than 65 international markets across India, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Its customer base includes over 9,500 laboratories and 2,000 hospitals and cathlabs, supported by a portfolio exceeding 22,000 SKUs across more than 200 brands in laboratory and cardiovascular segments.
The company’s business is structured into two core divisions:
Integris Medtech supports laboratories and hospitals across India, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, serving both public and private sectors.

Its European operations focus primarily on cardiovascular products, including proprietary brands like Chrome and Protégé, while its Rest of World presence spans the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America.

As of June 30, 2025, Integris Medtech employed 1,879 personnel, including sales, service, and application specialists, and had supported more than 15,000 patients across 100+ clinical trial sites globally, reinforcing its commitment to clinical evidence and innovation in MedTech solutions.
